questions.q: In which year did Ghana gain independence?
questions.why: It was the first sub-Saharan African colony to do so.

questions.q: Who led Ghana to independence and became its first President?
questions.why: He declared 'Ghana is free forever'.

questions.q: What was Ghana called before independence?
questions.why: It was named after its gold trade.

questions.q: On what date is Ghana's Independence Day?
questions.why: Independence came on 6 March 1957.

questions.q: Which powerful kingdom had its capital at Kumasi?
questions.why: Its ruler is the Asantehene.

questions.q: What is the sacred symbol of the Asante nation?
questions.why: Legend says it came down from the sky.

questions.q: Which castle on the coast was a centre of the slave trade?
questions.why: It is now a museum.

questions.q: Which queen mother led the 1900 War of the Golden Stool?
questions.why: She was exiled to the Seychelles.

questions.q: Which Portuguese-built fort of 1482 is the oldest European building south of the Sahara?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.q: Which group of six leaders helped start the independence movement?
questions.why: They appear on Ghana's cedi notes.

questions.q: Which flight lieutenant led coups in 1979 and 1981?
questions.why: He later won two elections.

questions.q: In which year did Ghana become a republic?
questions.why: Nkrumah became President that year.

questions.q: Which 1948 shooting of ex-servicemen sparked riots in Accra?
questions.why: Sergeant Adjetey was among those killed.

questions.q: Which ancient West African empire inspired the name 'Ghana'?
questions.why: It was in today's Mali and Mauritania.

questions.q: Which Ghanaian became UN Secretary-General in 1997?
questions.why: He shared the 2001 Nobel Peace Prize.

questions.q: Which Asantehene was exiled by the British in 1896?
questions.why: He returned in 1924.

questions.q: Who brought cocoa to Ghana in 1879?
questions.why: He brought pods from Fernando Po.

questions.q: What is Ghana's capital city?
questions.why: It is on the Gulf of Guinea.

questions.q: Which city is Ghana's second-largest and the Asante capital?
questions.why: It is called the Garden City.

questions.q: Which huge lake was created by the Akosombo Dam?
questions.why: It is one of the world's largest artificial lakes.

questions.q: Which country borders Ghana to the west?
questions.why: Togo is to the east and Burkina Faso to the north.

questions.q: The Prime Meridian passes through which Ghanaian port city?
questions.why: Tema is the city closest to 0° longitude on land.

questions.q: Which national park is famous for its canopy walkway?
questions.why: The walkway hangs about 40 m above the forest floor.

questions.q: Which national park is Ghana's largest and famous for elephants?
questions.why: It is in the Savannah Region.

questions.q: Which natural lake in Asante was formed by a meteorite impact?
questions.why: It is sacred to the Asante.

questions.q: Which port city near Accra is Ghana's main harbour?
questions.why: It was built in the 1960s.

questions.q: What is Ghana's highest mountain?
questions.why: It is about 885 m high, in the Volta Region.

questions.q: Which waterfall in the Volta Region is one of West Africa's highest?
questions.why: It is home to thousands of fruit bats.

questions.q: Which city is the largest in northern Ghana?
questions.why: It is the capital of the Northern Region.

questions.q: How many regions does Ghana have?
questions.why: Six new regions were created in 2018.

questions.q: Which river forms much of Ghana's eastern border with Togo?
questions.why: Its upper parts are the Black and White Volta.

questions.q: Which twin city lies at the western end of Ghana's coast?
questions.why: It is the centre of Ghana's oil industry.

questions.q: Which ancient mosque in the north is said to be Ghana's oldest?
questions.why: It is built of mud in the Sudanese style.

questions.q: Which mineral gave the Gold Coast its name?
questions.why: Ghana is Africa's top gold producer.

questions.q: What is Ghana's men's national football team called?
questions.why: The name comes from the star on the flag.

questions.q: How many Africa Cup of Nations titles has Ghana won?
Which team knocked Ghana out of the 2010 World Cup after Luis Suárez's handball?
questions.why: Asamoah Gyan missed the last-minute penalty.

questions.q: Which striker is Ghana's all-time top scorer?
questions.why: He scored 51 goals.

questions.q: Which Ghanaian midfielder was nicknamed 'Pelé'?
questions.why: He won the Champions League with Marseille in 1993.

questions.q: Which midfielder, nicknamed 'The Bison', played for Chelsea?
questions.why: He won the Premier League twice.

questions.q: Which Accra stadium is home to the Black Stars?
questions.why: It is also called the Ohene Djan Stadium.

questions.q: In which year did Ghana win the FIFA U-20 World Cup?
questions.why: They beat Brazil on penalties.

questions.q: Which boxer, 'The Dark Destroyer', was world champion in three divisions?
questions.why: He is one of Africa's greatest boxers.

questions.q: Which Kumasi club is one of Africa's most famous?
questions.why: Its nickname is the Porcupine Warriors.

questions.q: Which Accra club is Kotoko's great rival?
questions.why: Their matches are called the 'super clash'.

questions.q: In which World Cup did Ghana reach the quarter-finals?
questions.why: Cameroon (1990) and Senegal (2002) were the only African teams to do it before.

questions.q: Which Ghanaian midfielder won the Europa League with Atlético Madrid before joining Arsenal?
questions.why: Atlético won it in 2018.

questions.q: Who won Ghana's first Olympic medal, in boxing in 1960?
questions.why: He won silver in Rome.

questions.q: Ghana's 1992 Olympic bronze came in which team sport?
questions.why: It was the first Olympic football medal for an African team.

questions.q: Which team beat Ghana on penalties in the 1992 Africa Cup of Nations final?
questions.why: The shoot-out finished 11–10.

questions.q: Which music style, mixing brass bands with guitar, comes from Ghana?
questions.why: It was popular from the 1920s onwards.

questions.q: Which modern Ghanaian style mixes hip hop with highlife?
questions.why: Reggie Rockstone is called its godfather.

questions.q: Which Ghanaian dancehall star sang 'Kakai'?
questions.why: He featured on Beyoncé's 'The Lion King: The Gift'.

questions.q: Which rapper is famous for fast Twi rhymes and the hit 'Adonai'?
questions.why: He has won many BET awards.

questions.q: Which young singer had a 2022 hit with 'Kwaku the Traveller'?
questions.why: It topped charts across Africa.

questions.q: Which Ghanaian singer had a hit with 'Terminator' in 2023?
questions.why: It became one of the year's biggest Afrobeats songs.

questions.q: Who is called the 'King of Highlife'?
questions.why: He led the Tempos band.

questions.q: Which highlife star sang 'Aben Wo Ha'?
questions.why: He is one of Ghana's best-selling musicians.

questions.q: Which reggae-dancehall artist sang 'Most Original'?
questions.why: He has a BET award.

questions.q: What is Ghana's film industry nicknamed?
questions.why: Many films are made in Kumasi.

questions.q: Which 1980 Ghanaian film by Kwaw Ansah is a classic of African cinema?
questions.a: Love Brewed in the African Pot
questions.why: It is about a marriage across social classes.

questions.q: Which Ghanaian-born actor starred in 'Beasts of No Nation' as a child soldier?
questions.why: He won a Venice award for it.

questions.q: Which Ghanaian author wrote 'The Beautyful Ones Are Not Yet Born'?
questions.why: It was published in 1968.

questions.q: Which Ghanaian-American author wrote 'Homegoing'?
questions.why: It follows two half-sisters' families.

questions.q: Which playwright wrote 'The Dilemma of a Ghost'?
questions.why: It was first staged in 1964.

questions.q: Which playwright wrote 'The Marriage of Anansewa' and founded the Ghana Drama Studio?
questions.why: She drew on Anansesem storytelling.

questions.q: What is Ghana's presidential palace called?
questions.why: It replaced Osu Castle as the seat of government.

questions.q: Which Ghanaian Nobel laureate led the UN?
questions.why: He was Secretary-General from 1997 to 2006.

questions.q: Which sculptor turns bottle caps into huge metal tapestries?
questions.why: He won the Venice Biennale's Golden Lion in 2015.

questions.q: Ghana's carved 'fantasy coffins' are usually shaped like what?
questions.a: Something linked to the person's life
questions.why: A fisherman might be buried in a fish-shaped coffin.

questions.q: Which rice dish do Ghana and Nigeria compete over?
questions.why: Ghanaians often cook theirs with basmati rice.

questions.q: Which spicy fried plantain snack is a Ghanaian street food?
questions.why: It is seasoned with ginger and pepper.

questions.q: What is fufu made from in Ghana?
questions.why: It is eaten with light soup or groundnut soup.

questions.q: Which dish of rice and beans is a popular breakfast?
questions.why: Its red colour comes from millet leaves.

questions.q: Which handwoven cloth of the Asante and Ewe is world-famous?
questions.why: Each pattern has a name and meaning.

questions.q: What are Adinkra?
questions.why: Gye Nyame means 'except God'.

questions.q: Which fermented maize dumpling is eaten with fish and pepper?
questions.why: Ga kenkey is wrapped in maize husks.

questions.q: Which fermented corn and cassava dough is eaten with okro soup?
questions.why: It is a favourite of the Ewe and Ga.

questions.q: Which Ga festival 'hoots at hunger'?
questions.why: It is celebrated in Accra.

questions.q: Which Winneba festival involves hunting a live antelope?
questions.why: Two groups compete to catch it.

questions.q: Which northern millet porridge is called 'TZ'?
questions.why: It is eaten with green ayoyo soup.

questions.q: Which Ewe festival remembers the escape from Notsie?
questions.why: It is held in Anloga.

questions.q: Which is the only country that produces more cocoa than Ghana?
questions.why: Cocoa came to Ghana in 1879 with Tetteh Quarshie.

questions.q: Which Asante festival marks the yam harvest?
questions.why: It cleanses the community for the new year.

questions.q: What is 'shito'?
questions.why: It is made with dried fish and shrimp.

questions.q: What is Ghana's currency?
questions.why: Its name comes from the Akan word for cowrie shell.

questions.q: What is Ghana's official language?
questions.why: Twi is the most widely spoken local language.

questions.q: What is in the centre of Ghana's flag?
questions.why: It is the lodestar of African freedom.

questions.q: Which crop is Ghana's most famous export?
questions.why: Ghana is the world's second-largest producer.

questions.q: Which monument in Accra has a black star on top?
questions.why: Independence parades are held there.

questions.q: What is the language of the Asante called?
questions.why: It is part of the Akan group.

questions.q: What is Ghana's national motto?
questions.why: It is on the coat of arms.

questions.q: Which dam on the Volta supplies much of Ghana's electricity?
questions.why: It was completed in 1965.

questions.q: In which year did Ghana start producing oil commercially?
questions.why: Oil comes from the offshore Jubilee field.

questions.q: Which university in Accra is Ghana's oldest?
questions.why: It was founded in 1948.

questions.q: Which Adinkra symbol means 'except God'?
questions.why: It is the most popular Adinkra symbol.
